question_text: READING rows (DeviceName, SensorID, Kind) are ("Orchid", "S4", "heat"), ("Cedar", "S2", "heat"), ("Maple", "S4", "heat"), ("Ash", "S4", "light"). State the rows returned by SELECT DeviceName FROM READING WHERE Kind='heat' AND SensorID='S4';.
adaptation_rationale: Retains SQL selection/result tracing; the task supplies a complete query rather than claiming a two-table construction exercise.
solution: Orchid and Maple, in either order.
